economic_interpretation: The source mother identifies a short demand impulse and temporary supply contraction. Visual anatomy suggests that the mother is useful only when it is an early repricing from inventory or a genuine deep reset, when it is not a late half-year blow-off, and when demand remains accepted after the first breakout close. Market context is routed causally rather than inferred from later market returns.

compressed_rules.definition: At the source signal close, classify the stock as INVENTORY_ESCAPE when signal coordinate close is at least the maximum coordinate high of the prior 126 completed sessions; classify as DEEP_RESET_REPRICING when pre-impulse 60-session return is non-positive and signal coordinate close is at least 20% below the maximum coordinate high of the prior 126 completed sessions. Reject the middle/overhead state.
compressed_rules.rationale: Winners repeatedly began with first price discovery from a long inventory area or a genuine reset. Losers frequently represented a second spike beneath old distribution overhead.

compressed_rules.definition: For INVENTORY_ESCAPE only, reject when signal coordinate close is more than 50% above the first coordinate close in the prior-126-session window. DEEP_RESET_REPRICING is unaffected.
compressed_rules.rationale: The worst tails frequently occurred after a long half-year rise followed by a terminal rebreak rather than an early repricing. Fifty percent is a single economically broad extension boundary, not a searched cutoff.

compressed_rules.definition: The first and second scheduled market sessions after the source breakout must each have a fully valid, tradable stock bar with unchanged coordinate lineage, and both completed coordinate closes must remain strictly above the frozen inside-day coordinate high. Otherwise reject.
compressed_rules.rationale: Profitable charts usually accepted the new price area; losing charts often fell straight back below the frozen breakout level. Two sessions expresses immediate acceptance without searching observation windows.
compressed_rules.decision_at: close of the second scheduled market session after the source breakout

compressed_rules.definition: INVENTORY_ESCAPE is admissible when the signal-close market regime is BULL or market median-return acceleration (median ret20 minus median ret60) is non-negative. DEEP_RESET_REPRICING is admissible only when signal-close market breadth acceleration (positive-ret20 share minus positive-ret60 share) is non-negative.
compressed_rules.rationale: Continuation requires either an already positive habitat or improving broad direction; deep-reset repricing requires improving participation. Every input is known at the original signal close.

compressed_rules.definition: After R3 is known, buy only at the first legal executable open strictly after the acceptance decision, with maximum three scheduled market sessions of entry delay. Preserve T+1, suspension, price-limit, hard-valid, corporate-action and coordinate-lineage checks. Exit at +15% from entry when sellable or at the next legal open after 30 market sessions. Charge 20 bps per side.

predeclared_reports.components: Report the exact source mother and the incremental effect of each R1-R4 gate in the stated order; do not select the best subset.
predeclared_reports.market_states: Report BULL, TRANSITION and BEAR separately using the original signal-close causal state, without using future market outcomes.
opportunity_independence: independent signal dates per calendar year
economic_metrics: mean and median net trade return
